decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.2%), but three candidates — FPS, QCOM, and DAVE — showed full multi-signal technical confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising momentum, price above SMA-20, and volume surge). With $689 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into these high-conviction setups rather than holding idle cash, while leaving existing positions untouched to let stop-loss/profit-target rules work automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both down about 0.2%. Despite the flat overall tape, a handful of individual stocks bucked the trend with strong volume-backed breakouts. This kind of stock-specific strength during an otherwise neutral market session often reflects company-level catalysts rather than macro sentiment.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡,納指及標普500指數均下跌約0.2%,市場缺乏明確方向。不過在大盤持平之際,部分個股卻逆勢造好,伴隨成交量放大突破。這種在中性市況下出現的個股強勢,通常反映個別公司層面的利好因素,而非宏觀情緒帶動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Relying on a single indicator like RSI or MACD alone can produce false signals, but when RSI, MACD, price-vs-moving-average, and trading volume all point the same direction, the odds of a genuine move increase significantly. This is why today's buys were chosen only from candidates showing all four signals together, even though the broader market was flat.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 單靠RSI或MACD等單一指標判斷,容易出現假訊號;但當RSI、MACD、股價與均線關係,以及成交量同時發出一致訊號時,真實升勢的機會率會大幅提高。這正是今日在大盤持平的情況下,仍選擇同時符合四項技術訊號的股票作為買入對象的原因。
